Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast Versus Enemies episode 48 with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for Majors in end-game activities. The Bray Inheritance trait is really useful for PvE, returning from 0.46% to 2% ability energy from hits (the amount depends on the weapon archetype). Great kinetic slug shotgun - good stats across the board. While they're no longer the pillar for majors and boss damage they once were, they still work well as a weapon to swap to for burst or sustained damage. Fluted Barrel or Smallbore are your barrel choices for extra stability with a side order of handling or range depending on your preference. Assault Mag's increased fire rate is effectively a 7.7% boost to DPS, or Tactical Mag lets you get to the maximum of 8 in the mag with a Backup Mag mod. Reconstruction overfills your magazine to double size which means you only need to hit three or four crits, depending on how close you get to the magazine limit, for 11s (12s with the Enhanced Perk) for a 20% damage boost for the remainder of the magazine with Focused Fury. Recommended MW: Handling or Range, with a Backup Mag, or damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-Boss, PvE-MajorSpec, PvE-BossSpec, PvE-God, Controller, M+KB

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range/Handling] "Behold - the greatest PvE slug in the game. Reconstruction/Recombination is Classic Coke, and then Auto-Loading/Recombination is Diet. There's really not much to say on the PvE side - its pretty much perfect." tags:god-pve

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Handling] "Widely regarded as the greatest Legendary slug. There's a lot you can do with Heritage. Moving Target is fantastic on Slugs - +10 Aim Assist is huge. Killing Wind gives you a Diet Chaperone. Hip-Fire Grip is actually really strong here, and I've hit far more hip-fire headshots in the heat of the moment than you'd expect. Keep your Handling as high as possible - the range difference is fairly negligible from 80-100, we're talking about 1 metre of range (literally about 1 step in-game), and Handling is massively important." tags:god-pvp
